The '''Bastooine system''', also known as the '''Orellon system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orellon II]].
